newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Banks mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday with Banque Audi steady at $17 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce up to $12.625 from $12.5.
Solidere A held steady at $10.375 and B were also unchanged at $10.75.
Turnover in Banque Audi was 12,174 from 13,000 a day earlier. Only some 2,309 BLC were traded, down from Thursday's 9,000.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais shares, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 78,904 shares for a value of $910,270 against 81,925 shares and $931,925.
The BLOM index rose 0.01 percent to 903.33 and the LISPI index rose 0.10 percent to 81.57.
